> > | | one : () -> Int
> | | pair : (() ->{e} Int) -> (() ->{e} Int) ->{e} Int
> | | | emit : Num a => () ->{Console} a
> Int

> 3 : Int

> | | -- EFFECT MISMATCH -------------------------------------- <repl>

`bad` performs `Console`, which its annotation does not list.

1| bad : () -> Int
       ^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

2| bad() = pair one emit
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    () -> Int

but the body needs:

    () ->{Console} Int
> -- NAMING ERROR ----------------------------------------- <repl>

I don't know a value named `bad`.

1| bad
   ^^^
> bad : Num a => () -> a
> 2 : Num a => a
